method: Broad indexed sweep across all 12 mandatory Fortinet Community product areas using product-specific Technical Tip/Troubleshooting Tip searches. Community material is scenario-only and is never used as the primary lesson source.

recent_scenarios.title: VXLAN traffic does not follow SD-WAN rules over IPsec VPN tunnels
recent_scenarios.finding: Manual SD-WAN strategy changed preferred tunnel but some VXLAN sessions continued on the old tunnel; FortiOS 8.0.1 resolves route validation/session handling.

product_areas.selected_lesson_fit: No direct Multus CNI scenario; VXLAN case retained as SD-WAN path-selection scenario only.

recent_scenarios.title: Import configuration caused a security profile configuration conflict with another FortiGate
recent_scenarios.finding: Same-named Web Filter profile is shared in the ADOM database; importing either device can overwrite the shared object used by the other.

product_areas.selected_lesson_fit: Scenario-only question about ADOM object sharing; not used as the primary source for the bandwidth graph lesson.

recent_scenarios.title: No allowed logs in FortiAnalyzer
recent_scenarios.finding: Separate device-side log generation, archive presence, Analytics insertion and GUI display; FortiAnalyzer cannot create logs not sent by the device.

recent_scenarios.title: FortiAnalyzer log forwarding stops working after upgrade to 7.6
recent_scenarios.finding: Collector OFTP certificate CN mismatch and server-auth-state Query after upgrade; reload Collector license was the documented resolution for that case.

recent_scenarios.title: Analytics database size or range reduced after upgrading FortiAnalyzer to version 7.6 (ClickHouse migration)
recent_scenarios.finding: ClickHouse compression and regenerated hcache make disk usage comparisons misleading; validate date range and daily log counts before rebuild.

product_areas.selected_lesson_fit: Used as scenario-only diagnostic boundaries between content-pack availability and independent log-ingestion/analytics issues.

recent_scenarios.title: FortiNAC-F HA node not in control does not respond to RADIUS or Persistent Agent traffic
recent_scenarios.finding: A secondary node that is not in control should not be assumed to own active RADIUS/Persistent Agent listeners.

recent_scenarios.title: FortiNAC Manager synchronization fails with adjustRanks() failed - Role
recent_scenarios.finding: Global Role ranks may differ locally; a stale extra Role/GUID can break synchronization. Direct DB correction is case-specific and should be under support/backup controls.

product_areas.selected_lesson_fit: Scenario-only product troubleshooting examples; Docking Station Management remains the primary documentation topic.

recent_scenarios.title: FSSO group lookup fails because LDAP search times out in 5 seconds despite timeout settings
recent_scenarios.finding: Configured 30-second response timeout did not prevent an LDAP abandonRequest at about five seconds; missing FSSO users were a directory-search failure, not a firewall policy issue.

product_areas.selected_lesson_fit: Scenario-only directory lookup diagnostic boundary; primary lesson is SAML multi-value attribute construction.

recent_scenarios.title: How to reset FortiPAM admin password
recent_scenarios.finding: If all superadmin access is lost, the article describes a new-VM plus configuration-restore recovery path; MFA break-glass design is important.

recent_scenarios.title: Push notification issue after upgrading to firmware version 7.0.0
recent_scenarios.finding: Push notification appeared only after clicking Continue after upgrade; a version-specific MFA UX defect was under investigation.

product_areas.selected_lesson_fit: Scenario-only authentication/upgrade cases; primary lesson is the 1.9 login-page template migration.

recent_scenarios.finding: VXLAN traffic continued on an old tunnel after manual-priority/SLA changes; this is a path/session behavior case, not a multicast PIM configuration issue.
